audit_findings.title: Post-anchor debt cost may be missing from the numerator while its buyback benefit is captured in the denominator
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $900.0m debt and $14.5m H1 2026 interest expense, including $10.5m in Q2; computed 6.889m-share (12.7%) reduction from 54.275m to the supplied 47.386m denominator; exact valuation effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: The equity-level OE forecast starts from debt-free FY2025 earnings while the denominator reflects subsequent debt-funded repurchases; recurring interest therefore enters neither the anchor nor bridge, while fewer shares increase value per share.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025 , there was no debt outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated timing mismatch, not merely a possible parsing issue: the 10-Q reports $900.0m of actual borrowings used for repurchases and material post-anchor interest expense. The borrowing equals 15.1% of base equity value, and the associated denominator reduction is 12.7%, so the mismatch is reasonably capable of materially changing the per-share valuation even though correcting it would reinforce, rather than reverse, the conclusion that $231.67 exceeds the supplied valuation range.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile borrowing dates, daily balances and applicable rates to the repurchase settlements and supplied fully diluted share count; rerun every scenario with recurring after-tax interest deducted from forecast OE, or deduct the corresponding debt in the equity bridge, but not both.

audit_findings.title: The FY2025 anchor may retain a nonrecurring naming-rights gain
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $35.6m pretax gain; computed $26.1m after tax using the filed 26.8% FY2025 effective rate, equal to 6.3% of the $410.8m anchor and approximately $6.54-$9.12 per share across the supplied scenarios if retained
audit_findings.mechanism: If not removed, the one-time gain inflates anchor OE and all forecast and terminal cash flows derived from that anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: As a result of the amendment to the naming rights agreement, the Company recognized a $ 35.6 million gain with respect to the released portion of the liability.
audit_findings.explanation: The gain and its potentially material scale are demonstrated, but its inclusion in the OE workpaper remains unresolved. Management itself excludes the $35.6m gain from adjusted EBITDA and non-GAAP net income. If the OE calculation retained it, the resulting overstatement would be approximately $7.73 per share in the base case and about $5.41 in the 30%-MOS buy-below price, which is material to the valuation estimate although it would not reverse the present no-buy conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the FY2025 OE workpaper for an explicit tax-effected $35.6m removal. If absent, remove the computed after-tax gain from the anchor and rerun all scenarios and the buy-below calculation while retaining recurring sponsorship costs and remaining contractual payments.

audit_findings.title: The cash bridge requires a manual client-funds and trust-bank segregation check
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $198.0m corporate cash addition versus $3,006.1m client funds and $3,005.8m client-funds obligation; computed $0.3m client-fund surplus and maximum $4.18 per-share exposure if the entire $198.0m cash addition were unavailable
audit_findings.mechanism: Any client money or required regulatory capital included in the $198.0m would overstate the equity bridge; client-fund assets and their matching obligation should otherwise remain outside distributable cash.
audit_findings.evidence: Funds held for clients are classified as a current asset in the consolidated balance sheets because the funds are held solely to satisfy the client funds obligation.
audit_findings.explanation: The 10-Q separately reports $198.0m of cash and cash equivalents before client funds, while $3,006.1m of client assets are matched by a $3,005.8m obligation. It also independently confirms $900.0m of actual long-term debt and $900.0m of borrowing proceeds, eliminating the parsing-artifact concern. The record does not separately identify required trust-bank regulatory capital, but even the conservative upper bound of treating all $198.0m as unavailable is only 3.3% of the $5,970.0m base equity value and $4.18 per share, insufficient to change the valuation conclusion at a $231.67 market price.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June 2026 cash account and legal-entity schedule and the trust bank's regulatory-capital requirement; confirm that no restricted bank capital is included in the $198.0m bridge amount. No valuation rerun is necessary unless that review identifies a restricted amount.
